description: List the signed-in user's Foundaree QR codes with where each one goes, whether it is working or paused, and how many times it was scanned. Give an id to see one code in detail: its image, scans for the last 7 and 30 days, phone types, and every link it has had. Use it before changing, pausing or deleting a code, to find its id.

id.description: The QR id (10 letters and numbers), from my_qr_codes or create_qr_code.

search.description: Words from the name or link, to find one code.

name: my_qr_codes
title: The user's QR codes
